title: Software Engineer – Cloud Services – Rust
description: <div> <p><strong>About Tensordyne&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Tensordyne builds high-performance, power-efficient inference hardware, backed by our novel AI math approach.</p> <p>You will work within a team working on the inference backend software. Your focus will be on a part of a software stack of a future Tensordyne product.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and develop distributed cloud services in Rust</li> <li>Maintain Rust software developed in-house, as well as work with external frameworks&nbsp;</li> <li>Build APIs for generative AI</li> <li>Collaborate across different teams to derive design specifications and decisions</li> <li>Orchestrate agent teams to implement features</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with modern Rust</li> <li>Experience with agentic tools and workflows</li> <li>Knowledge of common Rust design patterns, including patterns for asynchronous code</li> <li>General awareness of network technologies and high-level protocols like HTTP</li> <li>General awareness of Kubernetes and other related technologies is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values</strong></p> <ul> <li>Put people first. We believe that a diverse team is better at tackling complex problems and coming up with innovative solutions. title: Product Manager
description: About Lio Build AI that runs inside the world's largest enterprises. Everyone is building AI. Very few are making it work at enterprise scale. At Lio, we're building the AI workforce for procurement. Our AI agents automate complex, mission-critical workflows across procurement, logistics, and finance for some of the world's largest companies. Backed by leading investors including a16z and Y Combinator, we're growing fast and tackling some of the most complex challenges in enterprise AI. We're looking for people who want to take ownership, solve hard problems, and build technology that delivers real business impact. The Role We're looking for a Product Manager – Pre-Sales & Go-to-Market who can bridge the gap between what enterprise customers need, what our engineers build, and how we bring our products to market. At Lio, product decisions don't happen in isolation. Every customer conversation, sales cycle, and implementation reveals new opportunities to make our AI agents more valuable. Your mission is to turn those insights into action. You'll work directly with our Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation teams to understand customer needs, shape product positioning, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, and identify opportunities that drive revenue. You'll be deeply involved in enterprise sales cycles, helping our teams communicate the value of our AI agents, build compelling business cases, and win customers. This isn't traditional Product Management. Our engineers own their features and make most product decisions. You won't manage a backlog or spend your time writing detailed specifications. Instead, you'll provide the customer context, commercial insights, and clear recommendations that help our engineers build the right things and our Sales team sell them effectively. We care about real customer value and commercial outcomes, not features that look impressive but never get used. What You'll Do Connect product and go-to-market: Work across Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation to align customer needs, product capabilities, and commercial opportunities. Get close to customers: Participate in enterprise discovery calls, demos, workshops, and sales conversations to understand buying criteria, pain points, and emerging use cases. Enable our Sales team: Develop compelling product messaging, use-case positioning, business cases, and sales materials that translate technical capabilities into measurable business value. Turn market insights into product improvements: Collect customer feedback, analyze win/loss patterns, and identify recurring opportunities for new or improved AI agents. Influence product decisions: Work directly with engineers to clarify customer problems, validate opportunities, and recommend priorities based on commercial potential and customer impact. Own product knowledge: Build and maintain the product and go-to-market knowledge base used by our teams and internal AI systems, ensuring capabilities, use cases, and proof points stay accurate. Analyze commercial performance: Understand how our products perform across customer segments, sales cycles, usage, and revenue. Improve pricing and packaging: Identify opportunities to strengthen our commercial offering, increase conversion, and unlock expansion. Understand the market: Stay close to competitors, industry developments, and emerging customer requirements. What We're Looking For 2+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales, or a comparable customer-facing role. Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within a fast-growing startup or scale-up selling to enterprise customers. Direct involvement in enterprise sales cycles, including discovery, demos, business cases, and commercial discussions. Strong technical understanding and experience working closely with engineering teams. Familiarity with AI and LLM-based products and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value. Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of what drives customer adoption, conversion, and revenue. Analytical skills and the ability to turn customer feedback, market signals, and performance data into clear recommendations. Excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus. A proactive, hands-on mindset with high ownership and the confidence to challenge assumptions. Experience using AI tools in your daily work. Procurement experience is a plus, but not required. We're looking for someone who can quickly understand a complex market and connect customer needs with real business opportunities. Why Join Lio? Shape how enterprise AI reaches the market: Influence both our product direction and how we position and sell our AI agents. Work at the intersection of product and revenue: Your work will directly contribute to winning customers and growing our business. Collaborate with exceptional teams: Work closely with engineers, sales leaders, and enterprise customers to solve complex problems. Build for real-world impact: Help bring AI agents into production at some of the world's largest organizations. High ownership, low bureaucracy: Take initiative, move fast, and have a meaningful voice in how we grow. If you're excited about combining product thinking, customer understanding, and commercial impact, we'd love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • Ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders

Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany and Luxembourg, with a HQ in Berlin.
 
ABOUT THE TEAM

Help us connect Microsoft Dynamics 365 with our wider technology platform. As part of a cross-functional team, you will work with product managers, business stakeholders and engineers to turn business needs into reliable software. Your work will combine Dynamics 365 and Power Platform development with Azure services, secure APIs and event-driven integrations, taking solutions from design through deployment and operation. .

 


What your work will look like:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Dynamics 365 CRM solutions on Dataverse, including data models, plug-ins, custom APIs, model-driven Power Apps, and Power Automate flows. Choose configuration or custom code according to maintainability, performance, and business needs. 

  • Build Azure applications and integration services using C# and .NET, with services such as Azure Functions, App Service, and API Management to connect Dynamics 365 with the wider platform. 

  • Develop and consume REST APIs, Dataverse Web API and OData endpoints, and GraphQL APIs. Define clear contracts, validation, versioning, and error handling with the teams that own connected systems. 

  • Connect Dynamics 365 and Azure services to Apache Kafka through integration services and event producers and consumers. Design for retries, duplicate messages, schema evolution and reliable data synchronisation. 

  • Implement secure service-to-service access using OAuth 2.0 and Microsoft Entra ID, including app registrations, permissions and managed identities where appropriate. Protect credentials and secrets with Azure Key Vault. 

  • Build and improve CI/CD for Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure applications. Use Git and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to automate builds, tests and deployments, including solution packaging, managed solutions, environment variables and connection references. 

  • Own quality and operability through automated unit, integration and API contract tests, code reviews, monitoring and troubleshooting: document technical decisions and support releases and production incidents. 

  • Work closely with business and engineering colleagues to clarify requirements, agree acceptance criteria and deliver usable solutions in small increments. 


What you need to be successful in this role:

  • Professional software engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Dataverse solutions in production. 

  • Strong C# and .NET skills, plus JavaScript or TypeScript for Dynamics 365 customisation. Practical experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, plug-ins, Dataverse data modelling and security roles. 

  • Experience developing and operating applications on Azure, with an understanding of cloud security, configuration, logging, monitoring and application performance. 

  • Practical experience with REST, GraphQL and OAuth 2.0, and the ability to design, implement and troubleshoot integrations across system boundaries. 

  • Experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven integration, including producers and consumers, consumer groups, delivery semantics and idempotent processing. 

  • Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD, particularly application lifecycle management for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, and deploying Azure applications. 

  • Sound judgement about software architecture, data consistency and maintainability. You can explain technical trade-offs clearly and collaborate across engineering and business functions. 

  • A degree in computer science, business informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

    Nice to have :

    • AI-assisted development using tools such as GitHub Copilot or coding agents to support implementation, test creation, debugging, and documentation. You review generated code critically and protect confidential data when using these tools. 

    • Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform, custom Power Apps components using PCF, or integration with Microsoft 365 services through Microsoft Graph.

description: Über IMMO PICTURES Gestartet in Köln, sind wir mit IMMO PICTURES heute NRW-weit tätig und wachsen bewusst mit Fokus auf Qualität, Effizienz und Kundennutzen. Unsere Kunden – von selbstständigen Immobilienmaklern bis hin zu großen Immobilienunternehmen – vertrauen auf klare Prozesse, schnelle Lieferung und konstant hohe Qualität unseres breiten Produktportfolios. Wir produzieren nicht einfach Medien, sondern schaffen echten Mehrwert für die Immobilienvermarktung . Unser Anspruch: Die komplette Medienproduktion auf hohem Niveau übernehmen, damit sich unsere Kunden auf ihr Kerngeschäft konzentrieren können. Wir denken mit – und um die Ecke. Deine Aufgaben NUR AUF VOLLZEIT-BASIS 40H, 30 TAGE URLAUB Operatives Tagesgeschäft & Auftragsmanagement Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unseren gesamten Auftragsprozess – von der Buchung über die Terminplanung und Produktion bis zur fertigen Auslieferung. Du koordinierst unser Team, verteilst Aufgaben, überwachst deren Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Deadlines und Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden. Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Aufträgen, kurzfristigen Änderungen und unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern den Überblick. Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft, findest pragmatische Lösungen und packst bei Bedarf selbst mit an. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere digitalen Systeme, Auftragsdaten und Dokumentationen stets aktuell und ordentlich gepflegt sind. Kundenkommunikation & Betreuung Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden – insbesondere am Telefon. Du beantwortest Anfragen, berätst zu unseren Dienstleistungen, koordinierst Termine und findest Lösungen für individuelle Anliegen. Du kommunizierst freundlich, offen und professionell und sorgst dafür, dass sich unsere Kunden jederzeit gut betreut fühlen. Du begleitest Interessenten und Neukunden vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Buchung. Du greifst lieber einmal mehr zum Hörer, als Fragen oder Unklarheiten offen zu lassen Prozesse & Optimierung Du stellst sicher, dass unsere bestehenden Prozesse zuverlässig funktionieren und vom Team eingehalten werden. Du erkennst Schwachstellen, hinterfragst Abläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns sinnvolle Verbesserungen. Du nutzt digitale Tools und Automatisierungen, um Aufgaben effizienter und übersichtlicher zu gestalten. Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen aktiv ein. Das bringen Du mit Must-have Organisationstalent: Du liebst es, Dinge zu strukturieren, zu koordinieren und den Überblick zu behalten – auch wenn zehn Dinge gleichzeitig passieren. Eigenverantwortung & Zuverlässigkeit: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass Dir jemand sagt, was als Nächstes zu tun ist. Du denkst mit, setzt Prioritäten und kümmerst Dich darum, dass Dinge erledigt werden. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist offen, freundlich, aufgeschlossen und telefonierst gerne. Du kannst auf Menschen zugehen und auch in stressigen Situationen souverän kommunizieren. Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis: Du arbeitest Dich schnell in neue Software und digitale Systeme ein und hast Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Digitale Affinität: Du organisierst Dich lieber mit digitalen Tools, Aufgabenboards und smarten Workflows als mit dem guten alten Notizblock. 😉 Lösungsorientiertes Denken: Du erkennst Probleme, übernimmst Verantwortung und suchst aktiv nach Lösungen, statt darauf zu warten, dass andere sie finden. Offenheit & Lernbereitschaft: Du kannst Fehler offen ansprechen, nimmst Feedback konstruktiv an und möchtest Dich kontinuierlich verbessern. Gute Englischkenntnisse Führerschein Klasse B und Mobilität über eigenen PKW Wohnort idealerweise Köln oder Kölner Umland Nice-to-have Erfahrungen in der operativen Koordination, im Projektmanagement, Kundenservice und/oder Office Management Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen, digitalen Projektmanagement-Tools oder Automatisierungen Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung Interesse an der Immobilien-, Medien- oder Kreativbranche Dein Start bei IMMO PICTURES Was Dich erwartet Echte Verantwortung: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tagesgeschäft, trägst Verantwortung für Dein Team bzw. die Sicherstellung aller Prozesse und kannst eigenständig Entscheidungen treffen. Ein modernes, digitales Arbeitsumfeld: Wir setzen auf smarte Tools, effiziente Prozesse und neue Technologien statt auf unnötige Bürokratie. Ein freundliches, motiviertes Team: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und ziehen gemeinsam an einem Strang. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Kurze Wege, ehrliche Kommunikation und schnelle Entscheidungen. Gestaltungsspielraum: Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wenn Du einen besseren Weg findest, möchten wir davon hören. Überwiegend Homeoffice & maximale Flexibilität: Du arbeitest grundsätzlich remote und kannst Deine Arbeit flexibel von zu Hause aus gestalten. Unser Geschäftsbüro in Leverkusen steht Dir jederzeit als alternativer Arbeitsplatz und für persönliche Treffen mit dem Team zur Verfügung. Vertrauen statt Kontrolle: Wir setzen auf ein sehr hohes Maß an gegenseitigem Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und selbstständigem Arbeiten. Flexibilität für Kundentermine: Während Deiner Arbeitszeiten solltest Du bereit sein, bei Bedarf auch persönlich zu Kundenterminen zu fahren. Jemanden, der auch dann den Überblick behält, wenn es mal hektisch wird. Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife.
 
Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis. Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften. Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. 

  • Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. 

  • Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. 

  • Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. 


Must-have

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. 

  • Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. 

  • Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. 

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. 

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. 


Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. 

  • Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. 

  • Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. 

  • Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext  und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. 


Was wir dir bieten

  • Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. 

  • Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. 

  • Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. 

  • Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. 

  • Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! 


Dein Weg zu uns

  1. Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. 

  1. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. 

  1. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. 

  1. Kurzes Rollenspiel (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Germany. Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people. Accountabilities: In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field. Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases. Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products. Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications. Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements. Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users. Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate. Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements. Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable. Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings. Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows. Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices. Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects. Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs. Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact. Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems. At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement. At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept. Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement. Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation. Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline. Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship. Ability to read research papers, assess new ideas, and quickly test relevant approaches through practical experimentation. An experimental mindset, with the ability to reason carefully about data, models, and evaluation while making iterative, measurable progress. Strong first-principles thinking and the ability to design practical, scalable solutions. A user-focused approach that prioritizes whether a product works effectively for its intended audience. Proactive ownership, urgency, attention to detail, and the ability to carry projects through to completion without constant direction. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nonengineering audiences. A commitment to responsible AI development and technology that delivers meaningful social benefits. Bonus qualifications: Experience with multilingual natural language processing or low-resource languages, particularly Swahili, Hindi, and languages spoken across East Africa and South Asia. Previous work in global health, international development, or social-impact technology. Familiarity with behavioral science or AI applications designed to support behavior change. Experience with data annotation pipelines and LLM evaluation methodologies. Knowledge of AI safety, alignment, or responsible AI frameworks. Experience deploying models in production and working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure. Publications at leading AI conferences or substantial technical writing documenting engineering research and results. Benefits: Compensation: Competitive within the mission-driven technology sector, with compensation positioned below typical big-tech salary levels. Remote work: Fully remote, asynchronous-first working environment. Flexible schedule: Work hours can accommodate your time zone, with no mandated core hours. International collaboration: Join a globally distributed team working across North America, Europe, East Africa, East Asia, and South Asia. Meaningful impact: Build AI applications addressing practical challenges in healthcare, agriculture, and other areas of international development. Technical ownership: Take projects from initial problem definition and model selection through deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. Interdisciplinary collaboration: Work alongside behavioral scientists, development economists, field researchers, and embedded engineers. Open-source contributions: Share technical innovations, tools, and learnings with the wider community rather than keeping all work within proprietary products. Professional development: Stay close to applied AI research and gain experience solving challenging problems in real operational environments. Autonomy and responsibility: Contribute within a small team with minimal hierarchy, direct feedback, and opportunities to influence technical decisions. Location eligibility: The role is open to candidates based in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. India falls within the stated eligible regions, subject to the hiring team's location and contracting requirements. Contract arrangement: International hiring is conducted on a contractor basis. raw.title: Publishing Product Director
raw.description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 


What You'll Do
  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation  
  • Serve as the source of truth on what the game is, what is coming next, and what it means for players, across Marketing, Comms, Community, and Commercial  
  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story  
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure  
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments  
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on  
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality  

    • What You Bring
  • 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams
  • Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure  
  • Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise  
  • Cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence without authority across game and publishing teams  
  • Strong player insight, audience segmentation, and community fluency  
  • Drive and operating range, comfortable moving from creative critique in the morning to commercial trade-offs in the afternoon  
  • Experience supporting or launching at least one major game or live-service title from inside the game team  
  • Track record of being trusted by both game leadership and publishing leadership  

    • What you can expect from us

    Career Path 
    Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
     
    Relocation Support 
    We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family. 
    You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).
     
    Company Apartment 
    To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.
     
    Public Transport Pass 
    Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.
     
    Gym Card 
    A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
     
    State-of-the-art Office
    We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.
     
    Hybrid Working
    We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.
     
    Equal Opportunity & Inclusion
    We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.
     
    German Classes 
    Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family. 
      
    Events
    Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!
     
    Vacation Days 
    At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from

Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d) to help us make Apaleo compliant, fast, wherever we grow next. You'll own the delivery of features that keep our platform compliant across markets, working closely with a Senior Product Management Lead who sets the strategic direction for the wider fiscal and tax domain. 

 

What You'll Be Up To 

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 
  • Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 
  • Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 
  • A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 
  • Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 
  • A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 
  • A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 
  • Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 
  • Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 
  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 
  • 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 
  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 

How You'll Make an Impact 

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see. 

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

description: Ready to Take on a New Challenge in Enterprise Sales? Are you a driven, energetic sales professional looking for your next big adventure? Are you excited by cutting-edge technology in a dynamic industry, and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact; not just on your career, but on the world? If so, we want to hear from you. This role covers the Turkish market, so fluency in Turkish is essential. Where You’ll Make an Impact: As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll join our high-performing EMEA sales team, reporting to the Regional Sales Manager and VP EMEA. You'll take full ownership of your territory and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the Crypto and Financial Services landscape. You’re not just here to sell, you’re here to transform how leading enterprises combat crypto crime with Elliptic’s industry-leading compliance and investigation solutions. You’ll gain deep product expertise and apply your understanding of evolving global and regional regulations to build compelling business cases that speak directly to our customers’ pain points. This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for a role where you can make an impact not just on the company you work for but also on the market you work in. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring! What you will do: Run the full enterprise sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest. Proactively identify, engage, and convert strategic enterprise accounts (including pre-defined targets and new prospects). Develop and execute multi-threaded sales strategies to engage diverse stakeholders (compliance, legal, risk, procurement, tech, C-level). Handle 5-, 6- and 7-figure deal cycles with skill, creativity, and precision leveraging persuasion, influence, and value based selling techniques. Drive account expansion through timely up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, maximizing value delivered to our customers. Partner with global peers to collaborate on multi-region and strategic global accounts with long-term growth potential. Collaborate with internal sales engineers, product experts, customer success, and marketing, as well as partner channels, to expand your reach and velocity. Stay ahead of industry shifts and translate emerging challenges into opportunities for Elliptic’s solution suite. Represent Elliptic at key industry events and conferences to strengthen relationships and identify new prospects. Be an ambassador of the Elliptic brand, living our values of curiosity, trust, and action in every interaction. What you will achieve in the first 6 months: Completed Elliptic's product certifications and onboarding processes. Mapped your territory, identified your top 20 target accounts, and built a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your quarterly quota through a combination of inbound, outbound, and partner-sourced opportunities. Identified upsell or cross-sell motion in an existing Elliptic account in your territory and have it actively in play to build a qualified pipeline of at least 2x of your quarterly quota through proactive whitespace mapping and engagement in collaboration with the Customer Success Managers. Run complete discovery cycles with at least 10 enterprise prospects, using the Value Pyramid to connect client pain points to our solutions, applying MEDDPPICC to qualify or disqualify with confidence, and have a clear view of what you're walking away from and why. Progressed at least 2 opportunities to late-stage negotiation and closed your first deal, demonstrating you can manage the full enterprise cycle from initial engagement through legal and procurement. Built multi-threaded relationships across your strategic accounts - compliance, risk, and C-suite - not just a single champion per account. Earned a reputation internally with your SE, CS, marketing, and partner team as a well-prepared, collaborative account owner who closes the loop and uses internal resources without wasting them. You will be a great fit here if you are: A driven, tenacious “hunter” who thrives on owning their number and finding creative ways to exceed it. Experienced in B2B enterprise SaaS and/or DaaS sales within RegTech, FinTech, and/or Crypto. A proven track record of consistently closing successful enterprise deals across multiple years and companies. Comfortable leading complex, long-cycle and large deals involving multiple stakeholders, but also agile enough to take on quick-close 5-figure deals. Commercially curious, you ask smart questions, seek to understand the "why" behind a customer’s problems, and use those insights to tailor impactful solutions. Confident, consultative, and persuasive, able to build strong stakeholder relationships at all levels, from mid-level managers to C-suites. A collaborative team player, independent yet never a “lone wolf.” You value and engage support from your pack. Agile, resourceful, and fearless, you see opportunity where others see blockers and know how to create inroads where none appear to exist. Willingness to travel to customers and industry events and conduct business face to face. Our ideal candidate has: Fluency in Turkish (written and spoken) is essential, along with professional proficiency in English. Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to establish meaningful relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders. Technical acumen with the ability to establish credibility with technical decision makers. Driven and solutions-oriented: you know how to navigate roadblocks and keep deals moving forward. Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology and Value Based Selling. Proficiency in CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), LLMs and other AI-driven prospecting and work efficiency tools. Passionate about generative AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry. Bonus Points for: An existing network of connections across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) space. Additional languages beyond Turkish and English such as fluency in French, Spanish, or Italian. A proven use case and understanding of agentic AI is a strong plus. Ultimately we are looking to hire those who want to be the future leaders in the industry, super intrigued by Crypto and have an awesome mindset to learn so if you don’t meet all the criteria still do apply! title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
description: Du gestaltest CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit – von der Segmentierung über automatisierte Journeys bis zur datenbasierten Optimierung. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle gestaltest du CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit. Du verbindest strategisches Denken, analytische Tiefe und operative Umsetzung: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in intelligente Segmente und automatisierte Journeys, analysierst die Ergebnisse und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Dabei hast du die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe der relevanten Systeme und Datenquellen im Blick. Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Du entwickelst dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kampagnen und nutzt Daten, um die Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Mission bei Foodji: Aufbau einer skalierbaren CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion im B2C-Bereich sowie Übernahme der strategischen und operativen Verantwortung . Verantwortung für den vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle: von Hypothese und Konzeption über Segmentierung, A/B-Tests und Kohorten bis zum Aufbau, zur Analyse und zur Iteration automatisierter Flows. Entwicklung dynamischer Segmente und Journeys, die unterschiedliche Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen. Eigenständige Analyse von Daten, Identifikation relevanter Hebel und Priorisierung von Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Tech und Analytics, um Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für relevante CRM-Maßnahmen zu nutzen. Verständnis der Zusammenhänge zwischen CRM-Systemen, Datenquellen und technischen Abläufen sowie Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft. Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft sowie sichere Anwendung von Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbaren Marketing-Automation-Plattformen als Core User. Hands-on-Umsetzung von Maßnahmen – von der Konzeption und dem Flow-Aufbau bis zur Auswertung und Optimierung. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Automation oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Praktische Erfahrung mit dem vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle – von Hypothese und Konzeption über komplexe Segmentierung, Kohorten und Flow-Aufbau bis zu Analyse und Iteration. Starke analytische Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägte Daten-Affinität sowie Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Kohortenanalysen oder vergleichbaren Experimenten. Erfahrung mit komplexen Segmenten und automatisierten Journeys in einem datengetriebenen CRM- oder Lifecycle-Umfeld. Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM- beziehungsweise Marketing-Automation-Plattform. Technisches Grundverständnis für die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe von CRM-Systemen, Marketing-Automation-Plattformen und relevanten Datenquellen. Strategische und operative Arbeitsweise: Du identifizierst Hebel, setzt Prioritäten und setzt Maßnahmen selbstständig um. Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Cloud Security Engineer
raw.description:
YGO.ai is a VC-funded AI tourism platform. We are hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to own the security of our cloud platform, the APIs our enterprise clients run on and the company itself.


🛡️ About this role. The role carries two things at once. You own security engineering directly and hands-on. You build the security function around it as we grow. At YGO a pod lead is a squad leader and a spokesperson, close to the work and close to the client, rather than a full-time manager. You will not stop being an engineer.

The work is broad. You might review source code in the morning, investigate an endpoint alert after lunch and help design a new authentication flow the next day. You identify the highest-risk problems, decide what happens first and execute.

We serve major travel enterprises and we have enterprise commitments going live from the start of 2027. Security is a condition of that business, not a layer added afterwards.

🧑‍💻 What you'll own

  • Application security. Hands-on code and architecture review across our APIs, backend services and internal tooling. Targeted penetration testing to validate issues yourself. Working with engineers on root causes and practical fixes rather than handing over reports. Vulnerability management and the external penetration tests we commission

  • Detection and response. Knowing we are under attack while it is happening and what happens next. Alerting, intrusion detection, incident process and the on-call path

  • Cloud and platform hardening. Access control, network boundaries, secrets management, containers and the deployment pipeline. Security through the SDLC: CI/CD, repositories and dependencies

  • The security of our APIs. Authentication and authorization, tenant isolation, token scoping and lifecycle, abuse prevention, enterprise SSO and the audit trail our clients and our own accountability depend on

  • The security of our AI systems. Prompt injection, tool and agent permissions, our MCP server, retrieval and data ingestion. The data-residency rules we are held to contractually

  • Identity and company security. SSO, MFA and privileged access for employees, onboarding and offboarding, access reviews, MDM, endpoint security and SaaS access. The practical IT security a company our size needs done, not discussed

  • Secure design across the pods. Threat modelling and design review that enables engineers rather than gatekeeping them and raises the standard of what they ship

  • The security function itself. Set the priorities and the roadmap from actual risk, not security theatre. Decide what we build, buy, automate or leave for later. Grow the team and hire into it, represent security to enterprise clients and carry our SOC 2 programme on Drata. Compliance is part of the job and it is not the centre of it

🚢 What you'll secure

  • An AI search and recommendation engine for major travel enterprises: enterprise integration, SSO, client security reviews, GDS integrations

  • A content enrichment API sold as SaaS: high scale, public facing, data and AI heavy

  • The platform underneath: a client console with organisations, projects and API tokens, supplier and business-client integrations, data ingestion, an MCP server, and several LLM providers behind a single internal library

📚 Our stack

  • Backend: Go monorepo (no framework, 3+ services)

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Redis Asynq queue

  • Hosting: PaaS-managed containers, Cloudflare in front

  • Observability: Jaeger tracing, BetterStack for logging, alerting and on-call

  • Compliance: Drata, SOC 2 in progress

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, used across the whole team

✅ You must have

  • 5+ years of hands-on security work spanning more than one discipline. Not five years of engineering with some security in it. This role sets the standard for the company, so it needs someone who has seen enough to have judgement rather than opinions

  • Application security depth. You know how modern web applications and APIs are attacked. You can validate an issue yourself through code review or a targeted penetration test and work with the engineer on the fix

  • A strong grasp of authentication and authorization. OAuth and OIDC, sessions, token handling, access control and the failure modes behind most API breaches

  • Cloud security fundamentals, properly. Identity, network, workload and pipeline security on a modern cloud platform, applied to production systems you were responsible for

  • Defensive experience alongside the offensive. You have investigated real incidents. You have built or improved the detection and alerting that catches them

  • Threat modelling and secure architecture for cloud, container and API systems

  • An engineering background. You are comfortable in a codebase, you can review what our engineers and our AI tools produce and you can build what you need yourself. Our backend is Go. Prior Go experience is a plus and not a requirement

  • Comfort in resource-constrained environments. Startups, small security teams or consultancies taught you to prioritize on risk, business impact and available resources and to execute yourself

  • The appetite to build a team. You want to grow this function and eventually lead it. Prior leadership experience is a plus and not a requirement. We would rather have depth and develop the leadership than the reverse

  • Working proficiency with Claude Code. Share specific examples

  • Judgement about pace. You secure a company that ships daily without becoming the reason it stops. Guardrails over gates

  • Experience of SOC 2, ISO 27001 or demanding enterprise security reviews

  • Excellent spoken and written English. You will talk to auditors, client security teams and our own engineers, often in the same week

  • ⚠️ European or African time zones (±3 hours from CET)

  • Available full-time (40 hours per week)

🌟 Nice to have

  • AI and LLM security: prompt injection, agent and tool permissions, model security, retrieval pipelines. Very few security roles let you both use AI as your main tool and secure it as your subject. This one does

  • Early security hire experience. You have been the first or one of the first security hires at a startup or scale-up

  • Experience leading or mentoring security engineers

  • Go

  • Security tooling or automation you built yourself

  • MDM, endpoint protection and identity provider administration (Google Workspace or similar)

  • Compliance automation tooling (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe or similar)

  • Security certifications. Valued as a signal, never required

  • GDPR depth. Travel or GDS exposure

  • German

❤️ You are a great fit if you

  • Can explain a vulnerability to an engineer and its business risk to a client's security lead in the same afternoon

Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk. Please Note: Tell us about a physical product you helped ship - what your team built, what went wrong on the way to production, and what your part in fixing it was. Your Responsibilities 🚀 Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management Own delivery: quarterly planning and OKRs with leadership, translating requests from our country organizations into scoped, estimated engineering work, and saying no with a rationale when needed Own the firmware release train (dev, canary, production) for the charger fleet and be answerable for fleet-impacting incidents alongside our operations teams Drive certification and compliance as a permanent workstream: Eichrecht (Modul B and Modul D), CE and EMC campaigns, VDE and TÜV interactions, DSO assessments and upcoming regulation and technologies like vehicle-to-grid (V2G), changes to the AFIR and such Manage key vendors and partners across the full bill of materials: our EVCC board supplier, meter vendors, payment terminal providers, the contract manufacturer running our production line, and our open source partners upstream Keep production shippable: end-of-line testing, BOM changes and cost analysis, supply chain risk, and same-day escalation support when the factory line stops Build a resilient team structure: develop tech leads, keep yourself off the critical path of IC work, and reduce bus factor on certification and hardware knowledge Your Profile ✨ Several years of experience managing embedded, firmware or hardware-adjacent engineering teams, including hiring, performance reviews and difficult personnel conversations A solid engineering background in embedded systems: you have shipped firmware or devices to production and can hold a technical argument with strong, opinionated senior engineers Comfort with the physical side of the product: electronics, EMC, test labs, manufacturing. You do not need to design circuits, but this world must not be foreign to you Demonstrated experience working with certification bodies, notified bodies or regulated products - or the appetite and rigor to own this quickly Outstanding self-organization: this role has many parallel threads (people, releases, audits, vendors, factory), and following through reliably is the single most important skill A track record of building self-managing teams: delegating, developing tech leads and staying off the critical path rather than being the hero Excellent communication skills in English, from firmware engineers to executives to external auditors Nice to have German language skills - a significant part of our supplier, certification and authority communication runs in German Experience in EV charging or e-mobility: OCPP, ISO 15118, Eichrecht, smart charging Familiarity with embedded Linux (Yocto), EVerest or other open source involvement, Rust or modern C++ Experience working with contract manufacturers and owning production or end-of-line testing Experience managing multi-generation products (legacy fleet plus new platform in parallel) Your Benefits 🪴 Flat hierarchies with efficient decision-making processes without red tape The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution Work on products that have a direct impact on the future of sustainable transportation Be part of an international and dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities Enjoy a flexible hybrid setup — choose how you want to split your time between our Munich office and working from home, with the possibility of workation within the EU, plus 30 vacation days Regular company and team events outside of the office to disconnect from our computers and reconnect with colleagues on hikes, mountain e-bike tours, offsites and more Personal and professional development through in-house Lunch & Learn sessions, collaborative knowledge sharing, as well as externally provided training, courses and conferences Discounted access to Wellpass for comprehensive wellbeing support - You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence.

If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk.

title: Senior GTM System Builder
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>The commercial team at Mews moves deals through a complex, multi-touch GTM motion. The person in this role owns the systems that make that motion faster, smarter, and less dependent on manual effort — from inbound routing and deal enrichment to Gong-driven coaching intelligence and CPQ automation. This is not a support role for the commercial team. It is an ownership role for the infrastructure they run on.</p> <p>You will join the Growth team to own an assigned domain within the GTM stack end to end: scoping, building, shipping, and running production systems that move ARR. You will work under staff technical direction but make your own architecture and build-vs-buy decisions within your domain. You will manage vendor relationships, define observability standards, and be the person who picks up the phone when something breaks in production.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would do</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>Own the full lifecycle of automation and AI-tooling initiatives within your assigned GTM pod: scoping, building, shipping to production, and iterating based on adoption and KPI data — not just ticket completion</li> <li>Build and ship AI-powered pipelines that permanently remove manual GTM work: deal enrichment, outbound research and routing, Gong-driven coaching signals, forecasting inputs, CPQ automation, and proposal follow-up</li> <li>Design the prompting architecture and agent logic that commercial reps, BDRs, and AEs interact with daily — reliable outputs for non-technical end users, with observability and error handling built in from the start</li> <li>Own operational health of your domain's live systems: first responder when things break, with adoption metrics, error rates, and data quality visibility instrumented before deployment</li> <li>Manage vendor relationships at pod level (Gong, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, depending on assignment): SLAs, incident escalation, business reviews, and periodic build-vs-buy re-decisions</li> <li>Support other engineers through code review, pairing, and coaching on architecture trade-offs — and contribute reusable patterns and integrations that accelerate delivery across pod</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> In this role, AI is not a productivity layer — it is the product. You will architect and ship LLM-powered agents, enrichment pipelines, and AI-assisted automations that the commercial org depends on. You will make engineering decisions about models, infrastructure, and MCP integrations. You will design prompting systems that non-technical users rely on without ever touching a prompt themselves. The test for everything you build is whether a KPI moved — which means your judgment about where AI is trustworthy and where it needs a human in the loop is part of the work, not an afterthought.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would bring</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>4 to 6 years delivering production software with measurable commercial impact in a product-driven company (high-growth SaaS, startup, or scale-up)</li> <li>Demonstrated end-to-end ownership with strong autonomy: you have defined the approach, navigated genuine ambiguity, and owned the outcome — not executed tickets</li> <li>Has shipped AI-powered pipelines or agents in a real operational context: enrichment, routing, summarization, or AI-assisted automation — not just prototypes</li> <li>Active practitioner of modern AI development tooling (Claude, Lovable, Cursor, or equivalent) and comfortable working with LLM APIs and MCP integrations — AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on engineering experience</li> <li>Hands-on experience building against Salesforce or equivalent CRM APIs: workflows, event-driven logic, and data integrations across multiple systems</li> <li>Comfortable owning live production systems: incident response, observability, vendor management, and data integrity — draws no hard line between building and running</li> <li>Can translate operational pain into technical requirements and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>Experience in or alongside a RevOps or GTM function — understands what commercial reps actually need, not the idealized version</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Gong API, Clay, LeanData, or ZoomInfo integrations</li> <li>Familiarity with Nue/CPQ, Databricks, HubSpot, Hook, or Ada</li> </ul><div
