Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>Anaplan is seeking a seasoned <strong>STRATEGIC ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE</strong> to drive its growth and expand its presence in the London area.&nbsp;</p> <p>In this role, you will take your proven track record of selling sophisticated technology solutions and account management and sell an incredibly versatile platform. Our sales team is helping industry leaders understand the impact of Anaplan products and how our connected planning solution is ending siloed decision-making. You will help our customers achieve their immediate business goals while setting their business up for the future.</p> <p>This role will be a catalyst to Anaplan’s continued growth while leading digital transformation. Reporting directly to the RVP of Sales.</p> <p>This type of territory requires someone to further build our footprint by hunting and locking in new strategic logos as well as rapidly growing opportunities within the current customer base.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">We are looking successful Enterprise AEs seasoned in closing 7 figures deals.</span></p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engaging with targeted prospects to identify broken business processes and position Anaplan’s unique ability to solve the problem,</li> <li>Build Anaplan’s business value throughout the selling engagement. Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to align the prospect around the Anaplan solution,</li> <li>Conduct highly effective presentations from Director through SVP and key C-suite level decision makers including CFOs, CROs, and senior leaders in supply chain, workforce, and other business functions,</li> <li>Develop customers and own opportunity management start-to-finish across multiple customer targets and functions,</li> <li>Apply Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology and tools to run sales processes and accurately forecast business,</li> <li>Employ outstanding account leadership skills to identify account expansion opportunities by cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within targeted accounts,</li> <li>Perform strategic sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business,</li> <li>Work with cross-functional members of Sales Development Reps, Marketing, Solution Consultants, and the Customer Success teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in consultative sales to Fortune 2000 companies, ideally in SaaS solutions (but not required)</li> <li>'Hunter' with a strong growth mindset, motivated by developing new business essential</li> <li>Experience in Industrial verticals, Retail, Energy, Manufacturing and Business preferred</li> <li>Shown success selling into Vice President / Senior Vice President buyers,</li> <li>Track record of overachieving sales quota &amp; targets, including demonstrated history of multiple high six-figure annual contract value (ACV) deals (services and/or software),</li> <li>Demonstrated network in your industry territory, with a mix of some customers and implementation partners,</li> <li>Demonstrated experience with sophisticated partner &amp; internal team organizations,</li> <li>Domain understanding (Supply Chain, FP&amp;A, Workforce Planning &amp; Sales) and knowledge of how these functions plan, process work and make decisions,</li> <li>Strong, demonstrated opportunity management practices (e.g. sales process, qualification, executive presentation skills, quote presentation and negotiation), and ability to balance multiple (3-5) opportunities at once,</li> <li>Business, Finance, Economics, related BS/BA degree or relevant years of experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Outreach, SFDC, LinkedIn Sales Navigator a plus,</li> <li>Account Planning experience Altify, MEDDPICC, Miller Heiman.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. raw.title: Master Data Management Analyst, Global Business Services – 6 Month Fixed Term Contract
raw.description:
Master Data Management Analyst, Global Business Services – 6 Month Fixed Term Contract

 

At IVC Evidensia, we are a leading veterinary services provider in Europe and North America with more than 2,500 clinics and hospitals across 19 countries and around 42,000 employees. We aim to have an extraordinary impact on animal lives, supporting in the region of 25,000 animals every single day across our international network. IVC Evidensia exists to champion the long-term health and welfare of animals and deliver our purpose of Healthy Animals, Happy Owners.

 

Our GBS Master Data Management Analyst is accountable for managing the finance master data requests from key stakeholders within both Group Finance and local in-country finance teams. This will involve triaging requests and ensuring that appropriate governance controls are executed, before maintaining master data in business systems. This work will need to adhere to service level agreement timescales and MDM governance rules and standards.

 

The MDM Analyst will partner with business master data requesters, Global Process Owners and subject matter experts to ensure that Enterprise Structure and Finance master data is maintained correctly in business systems. This will require an understanding of how master data flows across different business systems and an appreciation of related, core business transactions. The MDM Analyst will train and onboard business master data requesters and approvers.

 

In this role you will support the MDM Lead by executing actions to improve MDM processes and master data quality. This will often involve investigating issues, problem solving and suggesting improvement actions. The MDM Analyst will document processes and standards as required, as well as co-ordinating data cleansing activities to improve data quality in addition to having performance management reporting oversight with our BPO partner.

 

IVC Evidensia are going through an exciting period of significant change, and you will need to embrace and drive that change. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with strong relationship, business acumen, project coordination and analytical mindset to contribute to the organisation’s growth.

 

This role is initially being offered on a 6 month fixed term contract basis.

 
 

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities:

 
* Manage MDM request queue for Enterprise Structure and Finance-related master data, ensuring that requests are processed according to service level agreement timescales and necessary governance controls.
* Triage requests and determine the appropriate course of action according to business rules.
* Confirm requirements for hierarchy and mapping table maintenance with business SMEs.
* Maintain master data in business systems in line with rules and standards.
* Train and onboard new business master data requesters and owners as required.
* Support MDM Leads to implement master data quality standards and processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability.
* Document master data processes to cover full lifecycle of activities, ensuring these are modified as the business evolves.
* Work with MDM Leads and business SMEs to review and improve master data processes.
* Performance manage our MDM team situated with our BPO partner Genpact
* Performance manage leverage KPI’s and support regular reporting of performance
* Develop and implement master data validation checks and routines.
* Ensure master data accuracy through systematic validation procedures.
* Collaborate with external sources and partners for data enrichment where appropriate.
* Assist in troubleshooting master data quality issues and anomalies.
* Provide operational insights for master data improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate and execute master data cleansing routines.
* Collaborate with data owners, requesters and subject matter experts to identify and resolve master data issues.
 
 

Experience/Qualifications:

 
* Batchelors degree in Accounting, Finance or related field preferred (e.g. CPA, ACCA, CIMA)
* Minimum of 3+ years of progressive master data management experience with preferrable 2+ years’ experience in a global finance environment
* Experience with Oracle Fusion ERP or other ERP systems preferred
* Evidence of ability to develop and influence effective working relationships with senior business stakeholders in addition to managing relationships with our BPO provider
* Ability to provide challenge and hold to account teams in order to drive performance
* Possesses and promotes a positive attitude, with the ability to adapt swiftly and a willingness to undertake challenging tasks
* Ability to manage own time effectively, prioritising tasks, multitasking, and meeting deadlines
* Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to lead and motivate stakeholders.
* Build and maintain a relationship with Heads of Operations and other key regional & outside provider stakeholders, inputting into strategic decisions
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities in addition to having strong analytical skills to assess data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* Understanding of data protection regulations and confidentiality requirements in handling financial information.
* Proficient in using MS Office applications, particularly Excel & PowerBi, for data analysis and reporting
* Continuous learning mindset to stay updated with changes in global finance regulations and best practices.
* Interested in and an active contributor to automation and continuous improvement, recognising that small changes as well as big-ticket projects create a real business benefit

At IVC Evidensia we recognise that our people are fundamental to the success of our business. Investing in our people, premises and processes is at the heart of what we do. In addition to a competitive base salary, you will benefit from

title: Senior Recruitment Advisor
description: About the job At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact. Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,300 individuals, representing more than 60 nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow! Efficio’s Recruitment team plays a key role in identifying and securing the talent that supports our global business, including an extensive network of independent consultants, freelancers and interim professionals who work alongside our permanent consulting teams. We're looking for a Contractor Recruitment Specialist to join our global Talent Acquisition team, with a primary focus on sourcing and recruiting experienced independent consultants and interim professionals to support client engagements across our international business. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys proactive sourcing, building relationships with experienced professionals and working in a fast-paced environment where hiring requirements can change quickly. What will you be doing? Direct sourcing and recruitment: Identify, approach and engage high-quality independent consultants, freelancers and interim professionals across procurement, supply chain, transformation and related specialist disciplines. Contractor recruitment delivery: Manage contractor recruitment requirements from initial briefing through to shortlisting, interviews, commercial discussions and engagement, working closely with internal stakeholders. Stakeholder partnering: Work with project teams, Staffing and senior stakeholders to understand project requirements, advise on talent availability and identify suitable candidates within often demanding timescales. Talent pipeline development: Build and maintain relationships with an international network of independent consultants, developing proactive talent pools aligned to current and anticipated project requirements. Market intelligence: Provide insight into contractor availability, market conditions, day rates and relevant specialist talent pools to support hiring decisions. Candidate relationship management: Develop long-term relationships with contractors, maintaining engagement between assignments and identifying opportunities for future collaboration. Recruitment coordination: Support the wider contractor recruitment and engagement process, including rate negotiations, onboarding coordination, contract extensions and redeployment opportunities. Recruitment data and reporting: Maintain accurate candidate and recruitment records, track recruitment activity and provide visibility of contractor pipelines and progress against requirements. Continuous improvement: Work collaboratively with the wider Recruitment team to improve sourcing strategies, recruitment processes and the overall contractor experience. About You We're looking for someone who has: 3–5 years' recruitment experience within contract, interim or freelance recruitment, either in an agency or in-house environment. Strong direct sourcing capabilities, with a proven ability to identify, approach and engage experienced professionals who may not be actively looking for opportunities. Experience recruiting professional, technical, consulting or specialist roles, ideally within management consulting, procurement, supply chain or professional services. An understanding of the contract recruitment market, including contractor availability, day rates and the differences between permanent and interim recruitment. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work directly with hiring managers, project teams and senior business stakeholders. Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage experienced independent professionals. The ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously, prioritise effectively and respond quickly to changing business needs. A proactive, commercially aware and resourceful approach to recruitment, with a genuine interest in developing specialist talent networks. Experience recruiting internationally would be advantageous, although not essential.   Why Join Us? You'll join a collaborative global Recruitment team and play an important role in supporting the delivery of Efficio's client engagements around the world. You'll have the opportunity to work with experienced consulting professionals, develop an international network of specialist talent and take ownership of recruitment activity that directly supports our business. If you enjoy the pace and variety of contractor recruitment, building long-term relationships and proactively finding great talent, we'd love to hear from you.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Embed G2 within partner revenue teams, building the relationships and cadence needed to keep G2 top of mind as a growth lever for them. This position reports directly to the Manager, Customer Success and receives functional direction from the Director, Technical Support.   What You’ll Do Own resolution of escalated, high-severity, or cross-system customer issues, providing clear and timely customer communication while balancing speed, technical quality, and customer impact.   Lead root-cause and trend analysis for complex or recurring issues, quantify customer and support impact, and partner with Engineering to implement and validate corrective actions that reduce repeat cases. Represent customer impact in defect triage and product feedback forums by providing clear evidence, use cases, severity context, and recommended priorities. Define and improve support playbooks, escalation paths, and diagnostic standards. Create and maintain reusable technical guidance, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge articles, and apply that content to new-hire onboarding and ongoing team development.   What We’re Looking For Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience investigating complex technical issues in enterprise software support, systems engineering, digital forensics, or a related technical environment. Demonstrated experience coaching technical support professionals and developing or improving diagnostic practices, escalation standards, or support procedures. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people. Accountabilities: In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field. Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases. Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products. Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications. Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements. Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users. Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nonengineering audiences. This community is responsible for how users access, configure and interact with their data. That creates significant frontend challenges around large-scale datasets, filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and increasingly AI-powered experiences.

  • Spend approximately 80% of your time as a hands-on engineer, designing, building and shipping production features.
  • Work on complex, data-heavy frontend problems where performance, usability and scale all matter.
  • Build sophisticated interfaces for displaying, filtering and interacting with large datasets.
  • Work with React, TypeScript and JavaScript, while contributing to the wider technical decisions behind the product.

    • This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role where you step away from the code. You will remain a senior individual contributor and be expected to ship.

    At Pigment, people management and technical leadership are deliberately separated.

    Tech Leads lead the technical direction of individual teams. Engineering Managers focus on developing engineers as people while remaining hands-on engineers themselves.

  • Help create an environment where strong engineers can continue to develop while doing their best work.

    • Engineering Managers typically support engineers across multiple teams within their community rather than "owning" a single engineering team.

    We’re looking for someone who is both a strong senior Frontend Engineer and an experienced people manager.

  • Significant professional software-engineering experience, with the technical depth expected of a senior engineer.
  • Strong recent hands-on frontend engineering experience.
  • Production experience with React, TypeScript and/or JavaScript.
  • Previous formal people-management experience. Ideally, you have already managed engineers rather than looking for your first management opportunity.
  • Experience owning areas such as coaching, career development, feedback and performance management, not simply mentoring engineers or leading projects.
  • Experience building complex product interfaces, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, analytics, data platforms or another sophisticated data-heavy product.
  • Experience solving frontend problems involving areas such as large datasets, visualisation, filtering, configuration, performance or complex workflows.
  • A strong product mindset. You care about what you're building, who is using it and whether it genuinely solves their problem.

  • The ability and desire to remain deeply hands-on in the code while managing people.

description: <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>At euNetworks, Finance plays a critical role in supporting strategic decision-making, driving commercial performance and enabling sustainable business growth. As a leading European provider of high-capacity fibre network infrastructure and Data Centre to Data Centre connectivity, euNetworks operates in a dynamic, investment-intensive market where robust financial planning and analysis are essential.</p> <p>euNetworks is seeking a commercially-minded Senior Director of Financial Planning &amp; Analysis to lead financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting and business partnering across the business. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, this role will take ownership of monthly financial reporting and deliver high-quality financial insights to the Board and ExCo to shape strategy and drive performance.</p> <p>Working closely with commercial and operational stakeholders, the Senior Director will act as a trusted business partner, translating financial data into actionable insights that support revenue growth, cost management and investment decisions. The role will also work closely with Business Operations to strengthen commercial performance analysis, forecasting and alignment between financial plans and sales objectives.</p> <p>This is an opportunity for an experienced finance leader with a strong commercial finance background to influence business strategy and drive financial performance across a growing European digital infrastructure business.</p> <h3><strong>What will you be doing?</strong></h3> <p><strong>Financial Planning &amp; Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the FP&amp;A function, overseeing financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis across the business.</li> <li>Lead, develop and motivate a high-performing FP&amp;A team, setting clear objectives and building the capability needed to support the business's growth.</li> <li>Own the monthly financial reporting process, ensuring accurate, timely and insightful reporting of financial performance against budget, forecast and prior periods.</li> <li>Analyse financial results, identify key trends and variances, and provide recommendations to improve business performance.</li> <li>Continuously enhance financial models, reporting processes and analytical tools to improve the quality and efficiency of financial decision-making.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Board &amp; ExCo Reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the preparation and delivery of financial reporting and performance analysis for the Board and ExCo.</li> <li>Translate complex financial information into clear, concise insights, highlighting key business drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.</li> <li>Support senior leadership with financial analysis for strategic initiatives, investment decisions and business planning.</li> <li>Ensure consistency, accuracy and alignment across management reporting, financial forecasts and executive presentations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercial Finance &amp; Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted finance partner to senior stakeholders, providing commercial insight and constructive challenge to support business decisions.</li> <li>Evaluate revenue performance, margins, operating costs and investment priorities to identify opportunities for growth and improved profitability.</li> <li>Partner with functional leaders to assess financial performance, challenge assumptions and ensure accountability against agreed business objectives.</li> <li>Translate business strategy into financial plans, performance measures and actionable recommendations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Forecasting &amp; Financial Planning</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the development and ongoing management of financial forecasts, budgets and long-range financial plans.</li> <li>Coordinate forecasting activities across relevant business functions, ensuring assumptions reflect commercial priorities and operational requirements.</li> <li>Assess forecast accuracy, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and recommend appropriate corrective actions.</li> <li>Develop scenario analyses and financial models to support strategic planning, investment decisions and business performance management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Operations &amp; Commercial Performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Business Operations to align financial forecasts with sales pipelines, revenue expectations and commercial targets.</li> <li>Provide financial analysis of sales performance, customer revenue, pipeline conversion and commercial opportunities.</li> <li>Support the development of reporting and analytical tools that improve visibility of sales performance and revenue trends.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales and Commercial teams to strengthen forecasting accuracy, performance accountability and alignment between sales plans and financial objectives.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What do we want </strong><strong>from </strong><strong>you?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading FP&amp;A commercial finance functions, ideally within a complex, international B2B business.</li> <li>A recognised professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA) or equivalent preferred</li> <li>A strong commercial finance background, with a proven ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights.</li> <li>Experience owning monthly management reporting, budgeting, forecasting and financial performance analysis.</li> <li>Experience preparing financial reports and presentations for Board and ExCo audiences.</li> <li>Demonstrable business partnering experience, including the ability to challenge and influence senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience working closely with Business Operations or commercial teams to support revenue forecasting, pipeline analysis and performance management.</li> <li>Strong financial modelling, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and identify business trends.</li> <li>Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain financial performance and recommendations clearly to non-finance stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong leadership, organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver to tight deadlines.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in financial planning, reporting and analytical systems, alongside strong Excel and presentation skills.</li> <li>A proactive, commercially-minded and collaborative approach, with a strong focus on accuracy, accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Experience in Telecommunications, Digital Infrastructure, Technology or another capital-intensive industry would be advantageous.</li> </ul> <p>If this position is of interest but you don’t think you meet all of the criteria listed, please still consider applying. euNetworks looks to recruit people with the right attitude, potential and ambition and for the right candidate, we will provide further training and support to enable you to develop in the role.</p> <h3><strong>What can we offer you?</strong></h3> <p>At euNetworks we invest in our people by offering a range of benefits and development opportunities designed to support your professional growth and personal wellbeing. Employees have access to a comprehensive wellbeing programme that promotes mental health and also recognises the importance of work-life balance through initiatives such as a dedicated birthday day off and “give back” days to support volunteering activities. euNetworks’ bonus scheme is linked to both individual contribution and overall company performance with opportunity to overachieve in both areas. description: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling Hybrid in London or remote in the UK We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team. You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy. The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours. The role You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing. Live examples of the work: Causal estimation of offer terms. Modelling how amount, duration, and price shape customer outcomes. Unifying auto and manual models. raw.title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling
raw.description:
Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Modelling how amount, duration, and price shape customer outcomes.

  • Unifying auto and manual models. The two families were built without forced technical alignment. Finding a principled way to unify them on a common cost function is open work.

  • IFRS accounting model. A multi-stage credit model where information propagates back from later-stage recovery predictions to sharpen upfront loss estimates.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Whether a more general framing could replace both separate models is an open research question.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring.

  • Research mindset. You proactively explore new ways to add value. R&D time is when you expect to find the next step change.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere. You've influenced technical direction beyond your own projects.

  • Project leadership. You've owned modelling projects end to end, from spotting the opportunity through framing, method choice, shipping, and landing the commercial impact. You move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection.

  • AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and take on R&D that would not otherwise be viable. You use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Non-linear methods. You have shipped gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You have modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Python. The stack the team uses.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 – £120,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

raw.title: Account Manager
raw.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
  • Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.
    • Why Join our Account Management Team:
     
    At Aircall, you’ll join a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team that thrives at the intersection of success and growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your book of business, the support of dedicated technical partners, and the opportunity to help customers unlock the full potential of Aircall’s communications and AI solutions.
     
    This is an exceptional opportunity for stellar sellers who want to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive measurable business impact — helping them realize the value of Aircall through trust, expertise, and long-term partnership.

    Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.


As Senior CRM Project Manager for Personalized Promotions & Wallet reporting to the CRM Group Director, you will drive Veepee's promotional strategy across all six European markets (France, Benelux, Germany, Spain, Italy & Switzerland) and business scopes (Flash Sales, Brandsplace, Clearance, Media, Le Club).

 

You own two interconnected mandates :

 

1/ Maximise the ROI of promotional marketing budget — covering all voucher and incentive mechanics across the full customer lifecycle, whether funded by Veepee or by brand partners.

 

2/ Lead the CRM workstream of the Wallet & Promotional Products project — Veepee's flagship 2026–2028 initiative to transform the “Mes Promos” space into a personalized, gamified promotional wallet.

 

You operate at the intersection of CRM strategy, product development and data. You influence without direct authority, acting as the bridge between the CRM team and other main stakeholders (Front/Growth, sourcing, finance teams).

You are accountable for defining your OKRs, owning your roadmap and delivering measurable impact on promotional performance.

Promotional Budget Strategy & ROI Optimisation

  • Own the strategy and allocation of the voucher marketing budget across all lifecycle stages — acquisition, activation, engagement, reactivation.

  • Lead the execution with contribution of tech, data and operational teams
  • Define the right promotional mechanics for the right moment: welcome offers, cashback, brand-funded vouchers, targeted incentives, win-back promos.
  • Build and maintain a promotional performance framework: track ROI by mechanic, by market, by lifecycle stage, and by funding source (Veepee vs. brand partners).
  • Identify optimisation levers and challenge the status quo — push toward more targeted, more personalised and more cost-efficient promotional strategies.
  • Work closely with our CRM Data Steward to leverage the Voucher Performance tracking tools and A/B test dashboard; design and run structured tests on promotional mechanics.

    •

    • Act as the CRM lead on the Wallet & Promo Products project — Veepee's strategic initiative to reinvent the promotional experience for members.
    • Translate CRM strategy and member insights into concrete product requirements for the Front/Growth PM team.
    • Define and champion the gamification vision for the promotional wallet: mechanics, member journey, engagement loops — this is a blank page and yours to write.
    • Contribute actively to the product roadmap: challenge priorities, validate UX directions, and ensure CRM objectives are embedded in every sprint.
    • Coordinate with our Head of CRM Engagement & Conversion and our Head of CRM Traffic & Recruitment to ensure promotional mechanics are consistently integrated into lifecycle journeys and traffic plans.
    • Monitor the live rollout of product-specific promotions (currently in test) and drive the scaling strategy across markets.

      •  

      Cross-functional Influence & Alignment

      • Serve as the single point of contact for promotional topics within the CRM team and toward external stakeholders (Finance, Brand Partnerships, Product, Tech).
      • Participate in CRM leadership discussions and contribute to the CRM team's collective roadmap — promotional levers are a shared enabler across all lifecycle strategies.

raw.title: Responsable Qualité Stock / Chef de project Stock - H/F/X (CDI)
raw.description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Sous la responsabilité du Head of Clearance Offline - Stock & Data Quality, le/la Responsable qualité a pour mission principale de construire et maintenir les standards Qualités Groupe relatives à l’état des produits, de piloter leur mise en application et d’accompagner les évolutions nécessaires. Cette bonne qualification du produit est indispensable pour obtenir une valorisation juste du produit et choisir le canal d’écoulement approprié. 

Il/elle accompagne les entrepôts dans la bonne gestion du stock dont le service Inventory Management a la responsabilité afin de faciliter l’écoulement des stocks. 

Contexte et environnement de travail : 

● Poste situé en entrepôt : un entrepôt de référence - Mitry Mory (un entrepôt retours membres) et un 2ème entrepôt à couvrir : Blanc-Mesnil 

● Basé en région parisienne pour couvrir la zone nord de la logistique de Veepee

● Respect des consignes de sécurité et d’hygiène ; 

● Possibilité de port de charges lourdes et de postures contraignantes. 

● 1 jour de télétravail par semaine 

● Temps plein 

 

Délégation : Actions menées par le poste en autonomie et totale responsabilité : 

● Le/la Responsable qualité devra assurer ses missions en s’appuyant sur l’aide des gestionnaires de stock, des superviseurs et responsables de sites issus de la direction logistique ; 

● En toute autonomie il organise son travail de manière à délivrer les objectifs définis avec son manager et rendre compte de son activité et de son avancement ; 

● Il/elle sera le point de contact privilégié en charge des stocks Clearance pour les entrepôts et l’équipe Clearance au siège. 

● Il/elle devra être capable de demander les ressources nécessaires (humaines et/ou matérielles) pour attendre les objectifs fixés. 

 

Chiffres clés : 

La performance du Responsable Qualité Stock sera évaluée par des objectifs SMART définies par semestre. 


🎯 MISSIONS

Activités principales 

Activity 1: Quality Management 

1) Garant de l’implémentation des process Qualité 

● Être le promoteur de la politique Qualité Stock dans les entrepôts 

● Assurer le respect de l’application des processus qualité, notamment le Book Qualité aux postes des retours client 

● Assurer la formation de nouveaux opérateurs, et organiser les formations de nouveaux processus 

 

2) Réalisation des Audits 

● Audits qualité aux postes de retour B (retour client) pour s’assurer que les règles définies dans le Book Qualité et les processus sont correctement appliqués. 

➢ Réaliser les audits selon un critère de volumétrie de façon hebdomadaire ➢ Suivi et reporting du KPI, compléter le fichier centraliser d’audits Groupe ➢ Analyse du KPI hebdomadaire et définition d’un Plan d’Actions correctif si nécessaire afin d’améliorer les processus de qualification 

● Audits de l’expédition des ventes Clearance Online aux membres, afin d’assurer la qualité des produits et du packaging (en collaboration avec l’entrepôt): 

➢ Réaliser les audits selon un critère de volumétrie de façon hebdomadaire ➢ Suivi et reporting du KPI, compléter le fichier centraliser d’audits Groupe ➢ Assurer l’implémentation des processus qualité 

● Audit des retours: accompagnent à l’utilisation de Defect Tracker (tracking et correction des anomalies produit) 

 

3) Amélioration de la qualité du stock (physique <> IT stock) 

Être le point de contact pour comprendre les processus de l’entrepôt lors des enquêtes liées aux sujets Stock Data Quality 

Soutenir le déploiement de nouvelles tâches et de nouveaux processus visant à garantir la qualité des données de stock : 

● communication locale auprès des différentes équipes ; 

● suivi du déploiement via le pilotage des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) liés aux stocks ;

● recensement des alertes et des points de vigilance susceptibles de compromettre l'atteinte de l'objectif de qualité. 

 

4) Animer des points réguliers entre IM/site afin de suivre les différents sujets du service autour de la qualité. 

● Révision des différents sujets : 

➢ Dernières actions 

➢ Risques / Points d’alerte 

➢ Actions futures et feuille de route 

➢ >> Construction d’un rapport de suivi

● Identification de nouveaux sujets et des interlocuteurs pertinents 

 

Activity 2: Change Management 

Soutenir le BPO IM (équipe d'amélioration continue) dans le déploiement du processus et des outils. 

● Organiser la communication avec les équipes des entrepôts sur tous les sujets qualités

● Former les key users à tout nouveaux processus et s’assurer que toutes les équipes concernées seront formées par leurs managers. 

● Collecter le feedback/besoins d’amélioration pour chaque entrepôt et lever les alertes

● Participer aux comités des projets pour suivre et comprendre les détails et finalité ainsi que les impacts sur le stock et la qualité) 

 

Activity 3: Business Development 

● Suivre, implémenter et définir les processus de revalorisation du stock : repacking, réparation, recyclage. Suivre la réglementation en vigueur 

● Développer des opérations online dédiés aux produits repackagés 

Relations internes / externes
● Relations externes : prestataires, marques partenaires
● Relations internes : équipes des entrepôts de Mitry Mory, Blanc-Mesnil, Beaune et Lot &
supply chain team; IM team ; Finance ; BU ; Tech teams

👉 PRÉ REQUIS

Formation et expérience professionnelles
● Master 2 Logistique / Supply Chain
● Expérience professionnelle > 2/5 ans en logistique / fonctions de la Supply Chain
● Langue : Français et anglais (espagnol serait un plus)

Compétences comportementales
● Prise d’initiative/force de proposition ;
● Sens de l’analyse et esprit de synthèse pour restitution ;
● Sens de l’organisation et de la coopération,
● Gestion des priorités
● Communication/aisance relationnelle
● Orientation résultats
● Autonomie

Compétences techniques
● Management transversal
● Maîtrise du Pack Office, notamment Excel / Google workspace
● Aisance avec les outils informatiques (Manhattan serait un plus)


✅ AVANTAGES
  • 👉 Prime variable

description: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.   Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

 
The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.


Your Impact
  • Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance
  • Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows
  • Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles
  • Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope
  • Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data
  • Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

    • Your Profile
  • PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or
  • Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience
  • Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time
  • Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation
  • Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
  • Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques
  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++
  • Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery
  • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation
  • Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems
  • Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments
  • Interest in agentic engineering toolchains
  • Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices
  • A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

raw.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.
  • Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.
  • Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).
  • Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.
  • Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

  • Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.
  • The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.
  • After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions
  • Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)
  • Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging
  • Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams
  • Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance
  • Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration
  • Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes
What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Ben je een sterke starter met passende stages of projecten? Ook dan komen we graag met je in gesprek • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Duits is een pré • Je vindt het leuk om incidenteel klanten en productiepartners in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken • Je bent gestructureerd, planmatig en houdt goed overzicht • Je bent technisch analytisch en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar duidelijke acties • Je bent communicatief sterk en weet verschillende partijen op een prettige manier met elkaar te verbinden • Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en wacht niet af wanneer er actie nodig is Wat kan jij van ons verwachten? Binnen AEP kom je terecht in een technische en groeiende organisatie waar je veel ruimte krijgt voor eigen inbreng. title: Procurement Specialist
description: Over NovoServe NovoServe levert hosted dedicated servers vanuit meerdere datacenters in Nederland. We zijn een snelgroeiend bedrijf met een informele sfeer en internationale ambities. We zetten fors in op automatisering, om snel te kunnen opschalen en onze klanten optimaal te kunnen bedienen. Om onze snelle groei mogelijk te maken, ontwikkelen we eigen systemen voor IaaS-dienstverlening. Wij beheren een internationaal netwerk dat meer dan 7.000 fysieke servers ondersteunt, 19 Tbps aan externe connectiviteit biedt en beschikt over tientallen peering-partners. Onze netwerkinfrastructuur is verspreid over 8 datacenters op twee continenten, wat zorgt voor een hoge beschikbaarheid, veerkracht en een wereldwijd bereik. Kern van de functie Als Procurement Specialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige inkoopproces voor onze servers en netwerkapparatuur: van de behoefte-inventarisatie tot en met het contractbeheer. Je werkt op internationaal niveau voor onze datacenters in Nederland, de Verenigde Staten en Denemarken. Je onderhoudt en versterkt duurzame relaties met onze belangrijkste leveranciers en blijft op de hoogte van nieuwe, opkomende spelers. Je neemt het voortouw in de leveranciersselectie en het contracteringsproces. Hierbij zorg je niet alleen voor de beste commerciële voorwaarden, maar waarborg je ook dat alle afspraken voldoen aan de actuele wet- en regelgeving en onze langetermijnstrategie. Naast inkoop ben je de drijvende kracht achter ons contractmanagement. Je beheert het contractregister waardoor we tijdig kunnen besluiten te verlengen of juist over te stappen naar een andere leverancier. Dit doe je niet alleen; je werkt nauw samen met interne stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat de inkoop perfect aansluit op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Samen met Portfolio management signaleer je markt- en prijsontwikkelingen en risico's, en neem je passende maatregelen. Daarnaast organiseer je samen met interne deskundigen periodieke leveranciersbeoordelingen, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, risicobeheersing en commerciële prestaties. Hier herken jij jezelf in: Je bent een Procurement Specialist met ervaring in zowel technologie (hardware) als commercie. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met inkooptrajecten, bij voorkeur op het gebied van netwerk- en datacenterapparatuur. Met jouw sterke communicatieve vaardigheden weet je effectief te onderhandelen met leveranciers en samen te werken met collega’s binnen de organisatie. Je beschikt over minimaal hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, bij voorkeur aangevuld met enkele jaren relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare rol. Je hebt kennis en ervaring op het gebied van leveranciersmanagement en de inkoop van netwerk- en datacenterapparatuur.. Je hebt actuele kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving.Ervaring met ISO 27001 en bijbehorende aspecten van informatiebeveiliging bij het inkoopproces is een pre. Je bent vloeiend in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Dit bieden wij: een salaris tot € 5.000 -, bruto per maand (gebaseerd 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; mogelijkheden om parttime te werken; hybride werkomgeving; mogelijkheid om conferenties bij te wonen; mogelijkheid om certificeringen te behalen binnen jouw vakgebied.
